gloss: as appropriate; as needed; at one's discretion

definitions.gloss: as appropriate; as needed; at one's discretion; suitably
definitions.explanation: Doing something in whatever way is suitable for the situation, with the implication that the person may use their own judgment to decide the specifics.

examples.japanese: {適宜|てきぎ}⟦{休憩|きゅうけい}→休憩：00262_kyuukei⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{適宜|てきぎ}⟦{修正|しゅうせい}する→修正する：25527_shuuseisuru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The content may be revised as appropriate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{応|おう}じて→応じる：02018_oujiru⟧{適宜|てきぎ}⟦{判断|はんだん}して→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please use your own judgment as appropriate depending on the situation on-site.

notes:
A versatile formal adverb that grants discretion to the person doing the action. When a superior says {適宜|てきぎ}⟦やって→やる：02980_yaru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧, it means "handle it as you see fit." Also functions as a na-adjective modifying nouns.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {適宜|てきぎ}⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to respond as appropriate
- {適宜|てきぎ}⟦{判断|はんだん}する→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧: to judge at one's discretion
- {適宜|てきぎ}⟦{修正|しゅうせい}する→修正する：25527_shuuseisuru⟧: to revise as needed
- {適宜|てきぎ}⟦{休憩|きゅうけい}→休憩：00262_kyuukei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to take breaks as needed
- {適宜|てきぎ}な⟦{措置|そち}→措置：05519_sochi⟧: appropriate measures

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{適切|てきせつ}→適切：01621_tekisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: appropriately — focuses on doing something correctly; less about personal discretion
- ⟦{随時|ずいじ}→随時：16144_zuiji⟧: at any time / whenever — emphasizes timing flexibility rather than manner
- ⟦{臨機応変|りんきおうへん}→臨機応変：05663_rinkiouhen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: flexibly / as circumstances require — emphasizes adaptability to changing conditions

REGISTER:
Formal. Very common in business communication, official documents, and instructions. In casual speech, ⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧なよう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ or ⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ are more natural equivalents.
